newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast products steady on NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast products steady on NYMEX rally.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices held steady on Tuesday, with fundamental weakness offset by a late rally on NYMEX, traders said.

Downward pressure came from unleaded gasoline stocks, which fell 161,000 barrels last week on the West Coast, but remained 2.6 million barrels higher than year-ago levels, according to the American Petroleum Institute.

Buying has dried up the past week as refiners felt squeezed by the 21 percent drop in profit margins and high crude prices. A spokeswoman for Ultramar's California refinery said a partial shutdown was planned for later this week.
